title: Offline Hour Planner
one_liner: List your business tools and get a printable 'if this goes down' runbook with fallbacks and a priority order.
headline: List the tools your business depends on and get a live-sorted, printable outage runbook with fallback steps and an emergency wall card.

episode.title: Steve Jurvetson on the SpaceX Deal That Almost Didn’t Happen | EP #314

history.summary: A tight, well-scoped tool: the form, live priority re-sort, category fallback library, example loader and two-part print view all work exactly as the idea and acceptance criteria describe, with no dead ends and a clean phone layout. The generic-fallback approach is honestly disclosed and matches the stated data plan, though the lack of persistence and per-tool fallback editing are the clearest gaps between this and something an owner would return to monthly.
